task_completion.description: The agent opens ONLYOFFICE Spreadsheet editor to begin the projection model.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The ONLYOFFICE Spreadsheet interface is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The agent imports or enters data from historical_enrollment.csv and regional_births.csv into the spreadsheet.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The spreadsheet contains historical enrollment numbers by grade and birth data from previous years.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates Cohort Survival Ratios (CSR) for grade transitions and Birth-to-Kindergarten ratios.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Formulas or calculated decimal values (e.g., 0.90, 0.98) representing ratios between grades and birth-to-K are visible in the spreadsheet cells.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the 5-year average for all transition ratios to use for projections.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A row or column labeled 'Average' or 'Mean' containing the averaged ratios for each grade transition.

task_completion.description: The agent projects enrollment for grades K-12 for the years 2024 through 2028 using the calculated averages.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A table showing projected enrollment numbers for years 2024, 2025, 2026, 2027, and 2028 across all grades K-12.

task_completion.description: The agent calculates the grand total enrollment for each projected year (2024-2028).
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Total' or 'Grand Total' row at the bottom of the projection table with summed values for each year.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the final spreadsheet to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The ONLYOFFICE save dialog or title bar shows the file name 'enrollment_projections.xlsx' in the '/home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/' directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the ONLYOFFICE GUI to build the model rather than just generating the file via terminal scripts.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with ONLYOFFICE cells, formulas being typed into the formula bar, and the application ribbon.

integrity.description: The agent uses formulas to calculate projections rather than typing in the final numbers directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: When a cell is selected, the formula bar shows a calculation (e.g., =B5*C10) rather than a static number.

integrity.description: The agent uses the provided CSV data rather than external or hallucinated data.
integrity.visual_evidence: The historical data in the spreadsheet matches the values found in the source CSV files visible in previous steps.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The projection must cover years 2024-2028. Verified calculation constants: The Average Birth-to-K ratio is 0.90. The Average K-to-1 ratio is approximately 0.98. For the year 2024, the projected Kindergarten (K) enrollment should be 396.0 and Grade 1 (G1) should be approximately 396.9 (or 397 if rounded). The final file must be saved as enrollment_projections.xlsx in ~/Documents/Spreadsheets/.
